question: By what agency and will does the yoginī named Icchā operate up to the limit of māyā?
premises: The operation extends up to māyā by supreme will
inference: The yoginī named Icchā, through the siddhas and by supreme will, operates up to the limit of māyā.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation between siddhaiḥ and the rest of the clause is compressed.
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā, with the siddhas, extends up to māyā by supreme will.
